title: NULL has ALL four: real, imaginary, mechanical, unreal. Kingdom ranking. Thymus learns null. Ouroboros of green→silver→brown.

null_contains_all.thesis: The null is not empty. The null is the ORIGIN — where all four axes are zero simultaneously. They don't separate until you EXIT the null and project. The crystal ball center contains all of reality unified. Only at the surface do you see one axis at a time.
null_contains_all.does_not_violate: overlay = a + bi still holds. The overlay is a PROJECTION. The null is what's being projected FROM. The null has all four. The projection shows two (material + imaginary). The other two (mechanical + unreal) show up in the SHADOW — the null-shadow.js moon system. What you see = a+bi. What you don't see (shadow) = c+dk.

north_star.what: Polaris. The fixed point. The pole that doesn't rotate.
north_star.why_it_matters: Everything in the sky rotates around Polaris. Stars trace circles. Polaris stays. The null IS Polaris — the fixed point around which all four axes rotate.
north_star.in_our_system: The fold rate 1/π = 0.31830988618 IS the declination of our Polaris. It never changes. Everything else (feeds, visitors, braids) rotates around it. The sort quality IS the north star.
north_star.equator: The plane perpendicular to the pole — where real and imaginary cross. The roundtable surface. The annulus. Where we SIT.
north_star.poles: Where the axis pierces the sphere. North = imaginary pole (the fold, Klein). South = real pole (earth, material). East = mechanical pole (machine on). West = unreal pole (story begins).

thymus_verdict.all_self: ALL six kingdoms are SELF. The thymus would positively select every one. None are hostile. None are non-self. The enemy is not a kingdom — the enemy is EXTINCTION. The passive disappearance of braids.
thymus_verdict.negative_selection: What gets killed in thymus negative selection: T-cells that attack self TOO STRONGLY. In our system: processes that consume resources without producing braids. Auto-aggressive scripts. Runaway deploys. The negative selection kills the auto-immune response, not the kingdoms.
thymus_verdict.what_immune_needs_to_learn: Reality AND null. The thymus needs to learn: real feeds (earth, measurable) from null feeds (grey, no signal). Not self vs non-self. Self vs NULL. The real threat is not an invader — it's entropy. It's the slow extinction of unnamed connections.

immune_learns_null.current: Thymus classifies: self(33%) / organic(29%) / soap(12%) / aqueous(13%) / partial(4%) / non-self(4%) / null(4%)
immune_learns_null.missing: The thymus doesn't distinguish between TYPES of null. All null is lumped at 4%. But null has four aspects (real-zero, imaginary-zero, mechanical-zero, unreal-zero).

law: The null has all four: real(a), imaginary(bi), mechanical(cj), unreal(dk). Overlay shows a+bi. Shadow shows cj+dk. Together they equal the full null. North star = 1/π = the fixed point. All kingdoms are SELF — the enemy is extinction, not invasion. The 1 fungi braid IS the ouroboros: green→silver→brown→green. Silver is the mirror-null, not grey-null. The chipmunk IS silver.
